settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_TRUST_ANCHORS
settings.description: This entity's superiors, space- or comma-separated Entity Identifiers, published as its authority_hints; with PingFederate's own issuer in the list it is an anchor instead and publishes trust_mark_issuers and trust_mark_owners. An anchor is recognised with or without a trailing slash, and whatever the case of its host

when_wrong.detail: Unset or blank, or an entry that is not an Entity Identifier (an https URL with a host and no query, fragment or user info): the federation servlet does not start, and the reason names the entry

settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_SUBORDINATES
settings.description: Entities this one vouches for, space- or comma-separated: /federation/fetch issues a statement about each with the keys its own configuration publishes, and /federation/list lists them

when_wrong.detail: A bad entry fails when it is fetched

settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_SIGNING_ALG
settings.description: How this entity signs its statements, with PingFederate's current RSA key

when_wrong.detail: Anything but RS256 or PS256, in any case: the federation servlet does not start

settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_ORGANIZATION_NAME
settings.description: organization_name in this entity's federation_entity metadata

when_wrong.detail: Published as given

settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_CLIENT_REGISTRATION_TYPES
settings.description: What client_registration_types_supported advertises, space- or comma-separated; none advertises neither and omits the registration endpoint, and federation_registration_endpoint is published only with explicit. Advertising only: registration works whatever it says

when_wrong.detail: A list of nothing, or none beside another word: the federation servlet does not start. Unknown words are published as given

settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_RESOLVE_DISCOVERY
settings.description: Who the resolve endpoint answers for: known, only this entity, its subordinates and the entities it hosts (18.1); any, anyone

when_wrong.detail: Anything but known or any, in any case: the federation servlet does not start

settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_ATTESTER_JWKS
settings.description: The co-hosted attester's public keys, published as oauth_client_attester.jwks so other authorisation servers can trust its attestations through the federation

when_wrong.detail: Not one JSON object, not a JWK Set, or a key that is not public: the federation servlet does not start

settings.name: corsEnabled
settings.description: Whether every federation endpoint sends CORS headers

when_wrong.detail: Not true or false, in any case: the federation servlet does not start (under development a spelling the reader before 0.6.0 took, such as yes, is read as it read it, false, with a warning)

settings.name: corsAllowOrigin
settings.description: Access-Control-Allow-Origin on the federation endpoints

when_wrong.detail: Sent as given

settings.name: corsAllowMethods
settings.description: Access-Control-Allow-Methods on the federation endpoints

when_wrong.detail: Sent as given

settings.name: corsAllowHeaders
settings.description: Access-Control-Allow-Headers on the federation endpoints

when_wrong.detail: Sent as given

settings.name: corsMaxAge
settings.description: Access-Control-Max-Age on the federation endpoints, in seconds

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number that fits an int: the federation servlet does not start

settings.name: tokenEndpointAuthMethodsSupported
settings.description: token_endpoint_auth_methods_supported in the openid_provider metadata, space- or comma-separated

when_wrong.detail: A list of nothing (a comma alone): the federation servlet does not start. Otherwise published as given

settings.name: clientAttestationSigningAlgValuesSupported
settings.description: client_attestation_signing_alg_values_supported in the openid_provider metadata, space- or comma-separated

when_wrong.detail: A list of nothing (a comma alone): the federation servlet does not start. Otherwise published as given

settings.name: clientAttestationPopSigningAlgValuesSupported
settings.description: client_attestation_pop_signing_alg_values_supported in the openid_provider metadata, space- or comma-separated

when_wrong.detail: A list of nothing (a comma alone): the federation servlet does not start. Otherwise published as given

settings.name: dpopSigningAlgValuesSupported
settings.description: dpop_signing_alg_values_supported in the openid_provider metadata, space- or comma-separated

when_wrong.detail: A list of nothing (a comma alone): the federation servlet does not start. Otherwise published as given

settings.name: clientAttestationFormatsSupported
settings.description: Read and kept, space- or comma-separated, and never published

when_wrong.detail: A list of nothing (a comma alone): the federation servlet does not start. Otherwise it has no effect

settings.name: clientAttestationPopMethodsSupported
settings.description: The attestation proof-of-possession methods the openid_provider metadata advertises, space- or comma-separated

when_wrong.detail: A list of nothing (a comma alone): the federation servlet does not start. Otherwise published as given

settings.name: attestationChallengeEndpointEnabled
settings.description: Whether the openid_provider metadata advertises the attestation challenge endpoint

when_wrong.detail: Not true or false, in any case: the federation servlet does not start (under development a spelling the reader before 0.6.0 took, such as yes, is read as it read it, false, with a warning)

settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_IGNORE_SSL_ERRORS
settings.description: Whether federation fetches skip certificate checks, for a test federation only: the federation servlet's own (resolve, Trust Mark status), registration's, the OGNL criteria's and attestation's, read as one setting by every one of them (F-0197). The federation servlet also reads its init-param ignoreSslErrors, first; PDP calls always check

when_wrong.detail: Not true or false, in any case, or the superseded name set to a different value: the components that read it do not start (under development a spelling the reader before 0.6.0 took, such as yes, is read as it read it, false, with a warning)
